propositions: Replace GitHub-only gh workflow disable/enable with durable provider-neutral pause ownership for destructive repair
Pause acquisition and CAS cleanup must be fail-closed: abort before mutation if identity missing, pause pre-exists, creation fails, or lock check fails
Cleanup must read pause and OID as one snapshot and only clear if reason matches invocation token, leaving pause untouched on CAS miss or mutation
Both fsck --repair and doctor --repair must use the same repair-owned pause contract without changing public vocabulary or non-repair behavior
Local, GHA, Jenkins, GitLab, and bare environments must share identical pause behavior without requiring gh binary
Two-actor contention must prove ownership replacement cannot clear another actor's pause
